faq.a: Enlarging an image beyond its original size may reduce sharpness. Reducing size generally maintains good quality. The tool uses high-quality canvas scaling.
When checked, changing one dimension automatically adjusts the other to maintain the original width-to-height ratio, preventing distortion.

faq.q: Can I resize to exact social media dimensions?
faq.a: Yes. Simply enter the target dimensions. For example, Instagram posts are typically 1080×1080 px.
